audit.whatIsWrong: The page called this HARD, 8/10, red tone, with all seven full-layer stages given to Yasuo — against a 56.58% win rate over 281 games and a content layer that gives Neeko all seven stages.
audit.why: Neeko is the favourite here: Yasuo has to stand at 475 range to farm with Steel Tempest, and a Tangle-Barbs root removes Sweeping Blade, which is the whole champion.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, tone #3ddc97, diffRating 4/10, all seven full sides set to Neeko with matching whys. Carry threat left at 8.5/10 — his scaling is genuinely high even in a lane he loses.
sources: champ-data/mid/ahri.js for the FAVOURED/#3ddc97 token pair

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, report[0] and spikes[0] told the reader that Wind Wall does NOT block Blooming Burst — spikes[0] says her Q and E 'are cast, not projectiles that his W Wind Wall blocks in the useful way'.
audit.why: Riot's own text has Neeko throw a seed and the kit flags Q as a projectile blockable by Wind Wall-class effects. Advising a player to Q into a live wall throws the ability away.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks Blooming Burst — never throw the seed into a live wall; it lasts 4 seconds and is 25s at rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits/neeko.json projectile flag, champ-data/_kits/yasuo.json blocksProjectiles flag

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown or range appeared anywhere; dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for Wind Wall.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s, 400 range, 4 seconds. Steel Tempest is a flat 4s at 475. Sweeping Blade is 0.5s down to 0.1s and cannot be re-cast on the same target. Last Breath is 70/50/30s and needs an airborne target.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the do's, the don'ts, report[5] and spikes[0]; the invented fifteen seconds replaced with 17 to 25.

notes: The biggest defect here was factual, not cosmetic: tldr/report[0]/spikes[0] told the reader Wind Wall does not meaningfully block Neeko's Q. The kit flags Blooming Burst as a projectile blockable by Wind Wall-class effects and Riot's text has her throw a seed, so that advice was throwing the ability away. Fixed. I did NOT make any claim about whether Wind Wall blocks Tangle-Barbs (E): the kit gives E no projectile flag, and per the brief an empty flag means unknown, not no — listed in unverified, and the rewritten text only says to angle E around the wall, which is right either way. The whole matchup was also mis-graded HARD/8/10 with all seven full-layer stages given to Yasuo at a 56.58% win rate; set to FAVOURED/#3ddc97/4/10 with the chart matching the content layer and packet.levelChart. The FAVOURED/#3ddc97 token pair was confirmed from an existing entry in champ-data/mid/ahri.js rather than guessed.
